features: UP TO 18H BATTERY: Enjoy up to 18 hours of playback (at 50% Volume) with the built-in rechargeable battery, while Rapid Charging delivers 100 minutes (at 50% Volume) of use with just a 10-minute charge.
TYPE-C CHARGING: Recharge quickly and conveniently with the Type-C charging port for uninterrupted everyday use.
IMMERSIVE SOUND: Powerful 10mm drivers deliver rich bass, clear vocals, and an immersive audio experience for music, movies, and calls.
ENC TECHNOLOGY: Environmental Noise Cancellation (ENC) helps reduce background noise for clearer voice calls.
